author: Veli Raiya
title: Fantasy map designer and character illustrator wanted
content: Looking for a fantasy book map designer + character illustrator! Definitely doesn’t have to be the same artist for both. Bonus points if you’re a fantasy author recommending someone you’ve personally worked with. See the next posts for more details. For character art, gravitates toward realistic, epic fantasy concept art rather than cartoon; book is lighter fantasy but wants grounded, lifelike art; open to styles; bonus for POC and a wide variety of ethnicities. Portraits for now, more if the style fits the series. For the map: detailed, immersive, classic fantasy-map feel, open stylistically. Contact: reply on the thread or DM @veliraiyawrites.

author: blekek.k
title: Illustrators wanted for trading card project
content: Hi warga threads! We're looking for illustrators for our little trading card project. Whether you draw professionally, as a hobby, are still a student, or already work full-time, feel free to reach out. We're looking for artists that draws anime/manga style illustrations, cartoon/semi-cartoon illustration, Pokemon / One Piece / MTG TCG artwork, semi-realistic illustrations, and any other art styles. Comment if you're interested or DM me directly! Contact: comment or DM @blekek.k.
